method: Two independent assistant reviewers using original plans and sanitized packets only. Source, routes, models, timing and runtime verdicts withheld. Root retained A scored rows because all quality/usefulness/component booleans agree; both originals preserved.
repeated_prompt_limitation: Reviewers saw these prompts during the first resource-aborted attempt. This is a separately graded recovery replay, not newly unseen cases or a new independent holdout.
